name: FreshBooks
description: FreshBooks is cloud accounting and invoicing software built for freelancers and small businesses. It combines invoices, expenses, time tracking, payments, projects, reports, and client-facing workflows in one service.
agentUseSummary: Connect one active FreshBooks business through the Relay Console OAuth app, then let agents inspect bounded business membership and privacy-redacted invoice summaries through three read-only tools. V1 excludes financial writes, client identity, contact details, addresses, notes, terms, invoice lines, payments, broader accounting, automatic pagination, arbitrary parameters, and raw FreshBooks API calls.

capabilities.label: Read business membership
capabilities.description: Read the bounded role and identifiers for the exact connected business without profile identity data.

capabilities.label: Read invoices
capabilities.description: List bounded redacted invoice summaries or inspect one exact invoice.

allowed.label: Read connected business
allowed.description: Read bounded identifiers and role for the exact connected FreshBooks business.

approvalRequired.label: List invoices
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five privacy-redacted invoice summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read invoice
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact privacy-redacted invoice summary by numeric ID.

blocked.label: Change accounting records
blocked.description: Invoice, payment, expense, project, time, client, and broader accounting writes are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private accounting data
blocked.description: Profile and client identity, contact details, addresses, notes, terms, invoice lines, payment details, and raw errors are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader accounting
blocked.description: Payments, bills, expenses, journals, reports, tax, projects, time, teams, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary FreshBooks APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, parameters, includes, automatic pagination, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Connected-business metadata runs directly; invoice reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact-business binding, bounds, audit, redaction, rolling refresh, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three exact FreshBooks read wrappers and attaches the encrypted business token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay Console needs a FreshBooks OAuth app, production client credentials, the two V1 scopes, branding/support details, and any required FreshBooks review before public OAuth can be accepted. This staging/code worker does not open provider consoles or capture credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create or approve the Relay Console FreshBooks app, enable user:profile:read and user:invoices:read, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/freshbooks/callback, store production client credentials in Railway production, authorize a test business, and verify all three reads, single-use refresh rotation, disconnect, revocation, scope denial, and exact-account denial.

evidence.supports: FreshBooks uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant with HTTPS redirect URIs, confidential client credentials, expiring bearer tokens, one-time-use rolling refresh tokens, and token revocation.
FreshBooks consent is scope-limited and profile read is the baseline scope used to discover the authorized business context.
The authenticated identity endpoint exposes business memberships with business ID, account ID, role, and active state; accounting endpoints are bound to account ID.
Invoice list and exact-invoice GET operations use user:invoices:read and the accounting/account/{accountId}/invoices/invoices paths.

FreshBooks officially describes the same FreshBooks product and account surface as FreshBooks accounting software. FreshBooks Accounting therefore resolves to the canonical FreshBooks provider rather than a second connector.
